scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to the binary Euclidean LCD neighbor graph. The proof is general and symbolic; exhaustive enumeration through \(n=6\) is corroborative rather than a substitute for proof. No claim is made for odd fields, Hermitian LCD graphs, nonadjacent common-neighbor counts, or strong regularity. Literature searches cannot by themselves prove novelty.
title: Edge-regularity and exact triangle multiplicity in binary LCD neighbor graphs
